review_text: Honestly one of the best headphones I've owned at this price range. The bass hits hard and the ear cushions are surprisingly comfortable. Been using it daily for 3 months with zero issues.

Keyboard is tactile and satisfying. Some keys feel slightly mushy compared to the Cherry MX version but for daily typing it's excellent. Zero flex on the frame.
Laptop runs cool under normal load. Gaming heats the bottom a bit but thermals stay safe according to HWMonitor. Fan noise is moderate.
USB-C hub works flawlessly on my MacBook. All 7 ports active simultaneously with no drops. Gets slightly warm but nothing alarming.
Mouse is surprisingly precise for an entry-level optical. Side buttons are clicky and responsive. Grip is fine for medium hands.
